summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GANOH Café Bistrô new features: search functionality with lupa icon and adicionais in product modals. All core features working correctly including search, product modals with extras, cart functionality, order flow, and kitchen management.
passed_tests: Search button (lupa icon) appears in header and toggles search input
Search functionality filters products by name/description ('café', 'omelete')
Product modal opens with product details when clicking items
Adicionais section in modal shows 8 options with checkboxes (Ovos, Atum, Queijo Branco, etc.)
Selecting adicionais updates total price correctly in modal
Quantity controls (+/-) work properly in product modal
Add to cart from modal includes selected adicionais in item name
Cart shows items with adicionais (e.g., 'Frango com Requeijão + Ovos')
Complete order flow: menu → cart → checkout → name entry → confirmation → tracking
Order tracking page displays customer name, items, status, and progress
Kitchen page shows Kanban board (Aguardando → Preparando → Prontos)
Kitchen status updates work with real-time feedback and notifications
Order management through kitchen interface with status buttons

success_percentage.frontend: 98% - All new features working perfectly, minor CSS selector issues in test scripts only
